content: Hello! Do you need assistance updating your account credentials today?
Yes, I need to reset my password for my subscription profile.
Of course. Please visit the account security page by clicking the link in your dashboard.
I’m on the security page. It’s asking for my current email address.
Go ahead and enter your email address tied to your subscription, then press the 'Send Code' button.
I entered my email and received a code via email.
Great! Please input the verification code you received in the field on the page.
Code entered. It’s asking for a new password now.
Set a strong new password, confirm it, and click 'Update Password.' This will finalize your reset.
Done! My password has been updated. Thank you for your help.
